QUOTE: Clew has five ways to set indexing conventions, and when they disagree the rule is simple... | 1 | CLI flag, or the `options` argument... | 2 | `.clew.yaml` ... | 3 | Facts the repo already wrote... | 4 | Known-ecosystem signatures... | 5 | Built-in name-pattern heuristics
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly lays out five ranked precedence tiers (CLI/options, .clew.yaml, repo facts, ecosystem signatures, heuristics) rather than a single override.
